Upgrade an esqlabsR Project to a ReportingFramework Project

upgradeToReportingFramework.Rd

Adds reporting-framework-specific configuration and template files to a project directory. This is the second step in the two-step project initialization workflow:

  1. Call esqlabsR::initProject() to set up the base esqlabsR project.

  2. Call upgradeToReportingFramework() to add RF-specific components.

Usage

upgradeToReportingFramework(
  configurationDirectory = ".",
  templatePath = system.file("templates", package = "ospsuite.reportingframework"),
  analysisSubfolderName = "ReportingFramework",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  keepEsqlabsRStructure = TRUE
)

Arguments

configurationDirectory

A character string specifying the path to the RF configuration directory to be set up. Defaults to the current working directory.

templatePath

Path to the RF template files. Defaults to the package templates.

analysisSubfolderName

Name of the analysis subfolder used for initialization defaults. This value updates ReportingFramework-specific template defaults such as `outputFolder` when `keepEsqlabsRStructure = FALSE`. Defaults to `"ReportingFramework"`.

overwrite

A logical value indicating whether to overwrite existing files. Defaults to FALSE. If an existing ReportingFramework project is detected in `configurationDirectory`, the upstream `esqlabsR::initProject()` step is skipped to avoid destructive reinitialization.

keepEsqlabsRStructure

If `TRUE` (default), keep the existing esqlabsR directory/layout values and only add reporting-framework-specific components. If `FALSE`, apply reporting framework default configuration values and transfer files generated by esqlabsR initialization into the new structure.

Value

Invisible NULL. Used for its side effects of creating directories and copying files.

See also
